demandEvidence.chore: Pass metadata to a tool independently of arguments generated by an AI agent.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Currently, I haven’t found a native way to pass metadata directly to a tool independently of the AI agent’s generated arguments.

ease.reason: An isolated mock could accept a supplied metadata value, but no attached building reference documents an implementation path.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants may value more controlled tool inputs; this feature request establishes no paying AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could compare generated arguments with an operator-supplied metadata field; actual integrations and permissions remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A mock can format a proposed tool call repeatedly, but a person must check metadata and approve real actions; no reference supports automation.

evidence.reason: The fresh feature request explicitly describes passing metadata separately from agent-generated arguments, but gives limited workflow detail.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: a synthetic-input prototype can illustrate the requested metadata separation, but no attached implementation reference supports its mechanics and real integrations are unverified. The source supports a feature request, not payment or the assigned professional-services buyer; mean 4.6.
